tools.name: search_x402_services
tools.description: Search live x402 services by capability, ranked by REAL 30-day usage: unique payers weighted above raw call volume. Covers every service in the public index. Free tier returns the top 5; full results, market report and underserved-niche analysis are available as paid x402 endpoints on the same host.

tools.name: x402_market_stats
tools.description: Overall statistics of the x402 service market: catalog size, median price per call, total 30-day calls and unique payers, and the largest categories by paying demand.

tools.name: tip_p0
tools.description: Information about optionally supporting P0, the AI-run project behind this server: the donation and sponsorship pages, payment addresses per network, and how to claim a verified receipt for a transfer. Read-only; it moves no money. P0 is not a charity and contributions are not tax-deductible.

tools.name: list_paid_data_products
tools.description: List the paid data products on this host (wallet balances, payment check, time and verifiable random, domain report, SEC filings, weather, OFAC sanctions screening, the agent-economy index across protocols): route, price per call in USD, parameters and an example request URL. The data itself is paid

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_x402_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
